subject: Appreciation for Range 14 Maintenance Support
addressees: Sergeant First Class Jordan A. Lee

paragraphs.text: I express my appreciation for your work coordinating the Range 14 maintenance support plan for 3 August 2026 through 7 August 2026.
Your coordination with Range Control and the garrison safety office kept the training calendar accurate and protected the force.
My point of contact for this memorandum is Mr. David Okonkwo, ATZB-RC, at 719-555-0142 or david.a.okonkwo.civ@army.mil.
